profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc., also listed as AURORA INNOVATION INC, is a for-profit public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, trading under the ticker AUR. Its website describes the company as focused on self-driving freight using a system called the Aurora Driver. The site says the Aurora Driver is built with hardware and software backed by verifiable AI and is intended to integrate autonomy into fleets.

The site presents statements about autonomous trucking between Fort Worth and El Paso, a hybrid model involving Werner professional drivers and the Aurora Driver, and integration with the Volvo VNL Autonomous. It also cites a projection that freight volumes will grow five fold between 2010 and 2050 and describes autonomous transport as a necessity, though these are claims from the site and its quoted partners.

In available records, no cases and no products are listed for the company. A Pennsylvania law exposure entry has a count of 154. The company is registered with CIK 0001828108.
